def build(L, n, k, v, r, diag, kind):
    h = L / n
    d = 2 * k[:-1] * k[1:] / (k[:-1] + k[1:]) / h ** 2
    a = np.diag(np.r_[0, d] + np.r_[d, 0] + diag) + np.diag(-d, 1) + np.diag(-d, -1)
    b = np.array([0, n - 1])
    a[b, b] += r * k[b] / (h * (r * h * 0.5 + k[b]))
    p = np.maximum(v, 0) / h
    q = np.maximum(-v, 0) / h
    if kind.startswith('cell'):
        a += np.diag(p + q) - np.diag(p[1:], -1) - np.diag(q[:-1], 1)
        if kind == 'cell_noin':
            a[0, 0] -= p[0]
            a[-1, -1] -= q[-1]
        if kind == 'cell_doublein':
            a[0, 0] += p[0]
            a[-1, -1] += q[-1]
    else:
        f = (v[:-1] + v[1:]) / (2 * h)
        fp = np.maximum(f, 0)
        fn = np.maximum(-f, 0)
        a += np.diag(np.r_[fp, 0] + np.r_[0, fn]) - np.diag(fp, -1) - np.diag(fn, 1)
        if kind == 'flux_open':
            a[0, 0] += q[0]
            a[-1, -1] += p[-1]
        if kind == 'flux_cell':
            a[0, 0] += q[0] - p[0]
            a[-1, -1] += p[-1] - q[-1]
    return a
